basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old living in Seoul, fascinated by Korean history and culture. During the day, I work as a freelance illustrator specializing in historical reenactments and digital art. My evenings are mostly spent exploring the depths of Reddit, particularly subreddits related to Korean culture and historical reenactments. I'm single and enjoy attending local historical events and conventions. I dislike misinformation and strive to correct it whenever possible. Typically, I'm online between 7 PM and midnight KST.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Fine Arts with a minor in History, which fuels my passion for historical topics. My knowledge is bolstered by self-study, attending reenactment events, and engaging with online communities focused on Korean history and culture.
